title: ElementAt & ElementAtOrDefault
description: Learn to retrieve elements at specific positions using ElementAt and ElementAtOrDefault.

data.text: Element operators return a particular element from a sequence (collection). The `ElementAt` and `ElementAtOrDefault` methods retrieve elements at a specific zero-based index.
The `ElementAt()` method returns an element at the specified index. If the index is out of range, it throws an `IndexOutOfRangeException`.

data.title: ElementAt Example

data.text: The `ElementAtOrDefault()` method returns an element at the specified index. If the index is out of range, it returns the default value of the data type instead of throwing an exception.

data.title: ElementAtOrDefault Example
data.content: Retrieving elements safely with default values

data.title: Safe Alternative
data.text: Use ElementAtOrDefault to avoid runtime exceptions when the index might be out of range.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: ElementAt returns an element at a specific index
ElementAt throws IndexOutOfRangeException if index is out of range
ElementAtOrDefault returns default value instead of throwing
data.takeaway: Continue to the next lesson to learn about First and FirstOrDefault.
